title: Azért, mert: A Stronger Reason for an Opinion

sections.title: Extra weight on your reason
sections.content: You already use azért, mert for a slightly more emphatic "because" than mert alone. It fits an opinion just as naturally as any other reason: open with azért, state your opinion, then finish the reason with mert. It's the version to reach for when you really want the reason to land, not just be mentioned.

items.spanish: Azért szeretem jobban ezt a filmet, mert izgalmasabb.
items.english: That's why I like this film better — because it's more exciting.

items.spanish: Azért gondolom, hogy igazad van, mert te ismered jobban a várost.
items.english: That's why I think you're right — because you know the city better.

items.spanish: Azért nem értek egyet, mert szerintem túl drága.
items.english: That's why I disagree — because in my opinion it's too expensive.

sections.content: By now you have a full toolkit for an opinion exchange: open with szerintem/azt hiszem/gondolom, compare with -bb + mint or say things are egyformán good, agree or disagree with egyetért/nem értek egyet, and always be ready to back it up with mert or azért, mert.
